adjudication.rationale: In `addGuestsHandler` the DB is mutated first via `prisma.booking.update(... attendees.createMany ...)`, then an external side effect is performed with `await eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking);` outside any transaction/compensation. If `updateCalendarAttendees` throws, the handler will error after guests have already been persisted, so the client can receive a failure while the booking state has changed (non-atomic, inconsistent outcome). Additionally, `sendAddGuestsEmails` errors are swallowed (`try/catch` only logs), making failure modes uneven and harder to reason about.
